title: Frequency-Aware Feature Fusion for Dense Image Prediction (FreqFusion)
mechanism: Decoder fusion with adaptive low-pass filters inside regions, offset resampling for inconsistent features, and adaptive high-pass filters that restore boundary detail lost in downsampling.
adaptation: Replace nearest-upsample + concat in each U-Net++ decoder node with FreqFusion; the high-pass path targets 1-2 px cracks and finger interruptions.
min_experiment: Arm: house PF with FreqFusion decoder; baseline: house PF; CV crack IoU, gridline IoU. Kill if both n.d. (crack < 0.012, gridline < 0.03).
evidence: R: abstract reports gains across dense prediction tasks; numbers not retrieved.

alt_notes.adaptation: Replace nearest-upsample + concat in each U-Net++ decoder node; the high-pass path targets cracks and gridline; test as one family with SFM.
